description: Player 1 deck for spec 50 (issue #3605): the busy-board frame probe's worst case. Five units that fill lanes 1-5 (Megabase the Legendary wall, Tylannt the Mythic anchor, Paragon Mk2 the Charger, Wrong-House Attacker and Stratos the one-cost loopers: every non-Mythic unit carries two or more when:"always" keyword loops), two one-cost traps for backrow lanes 1-2, and single-copy cheap spells and traps (Stockpile, True Strike, Knockoff, Rapid Draw, Burn and the rest of the one-cost traps) so the ten cards left in hand once the board is built are all playable. The handicap (R180) is spec 32's pattern with room to redraw: three bonus draws a turn refill the hand to HAND_CAP by player-turn 5, and 10 mana a turn plays the 9-mana unit row over the first two turns.
